_status: ADOPTED for merge-path enforcement by the operator order of 2026-10-19 (P6-CI-6 closure blockers); its severity-source and UNKNOWN readings by the operator decisions of 2026-10-19 (PR #232); the scope of the Trivy and OpenTofu executables the jobs run as CI tools by the bounded operator decision of 2026-10-21 (_operator_decisions.O1_2026_10_21). It governs only the required merge-path gates of .github/workflows/ci.yml (Container build and security; Revision reader; and, from the P6-CI-6 coverage-gap tranche the operator order of 2026-10-20 directed, the installed-environment and scanner-binary gates of Frontend quality, Backend quality, Migrations and API contract and Integration smoke). That tranche changed no adopted rule: it declared the scope of two new CI tooling lock targets and added the vulnerability analysis of the Trivy and OpenTofu binaries that the order of 2026-10-20 made an explicit requirement of its own. Which scope those binaries take was not settled by the order of 2026-10-19; the tranche's own sentence assigning them the tooling scope was its reading, and the operator decided the question on 2026-10-21. It changes no live environment, no deployment and no publish workflow: staging-publish.yml and reader-publish.yml keep their own Trivy steps and thresholds. security/gate.py enforces exactly what is written here and adopts nothing on its own.

_authority.vulnerability_severity_rules: ADOPTED (operator order 2026-10-19). CRITICAL findings fail in every scope (built images, runtime dependencies, and development, test and security-tool dependencies and installed tooling environments), whether or not a fix is published; neither fix availability, development classification nor missing FixedVersion metadata can filter a CRITICAL out. HIGH findings keep the treatment the merge path enforced before, unchanged: images and runtime dependencies fail when a fix exists (a non-empty FixedVersion, as before); development-scope HIGH findings are reported; unfixed HIGH findings stay listed as EXCLUDED. MEDIUM and LOW findings are reported. SEVERITY SOURCE and UNKNOWN: ADOPTED by the operator decisions of 2026-10-19 (recorded verbatim in evidence P6-CI6-closure-fix-review-request-01). The severity that decides the gate result is the Severity field that the pinned Trivy (0.76.0) selects by its documented default selection: the selected data source's vendor severity, else a severity derived from the CVSS score, else NVD, else other vendors' ratings in trivy-db's documented order of preference, and only then UNKNOWN. No source override (such as --vuln-severity-source) is used, and the reports keep SeveritySource, the alternate vendor ratings (VendorSeverity) and the CVSS data. The guarantee, stated precisely: Trivy-selected CRITICAL findings fail across the covered populations, with or without a fix. A finding that NVD or another vendor rates higher than Trivy's selection is evaluated at Trivy's selection, and the decision does not establish its harmlessness or remediation (disclosed cases at adoption, measured in the CI reports of 52d0aa6e: three CVEs that some vendor rates CRITICAL above Trivy's selection, namely CVE-2019-1010022 in libc6/libc-bin of the API and reader images, NVD 9.8, Trivy LOW; CVE-2025-69720 in libncursesw6/libtinfo6 of the three images, two vendors CRITICAL, Trivy HIGH, no fix, EXCLUDED; and CVE-2026-19445 in the reader image's python3.13 packages, two vendors CRITICAL, Trivy HIGH, no fix, EXCLUDED; in all, 166 report rows carry some vendor rating above Trivy's selection, and the complete list is kept in the review-request evidence record). A valid UNKNOWN severity means unscored: the finding stays reported for triage and is not LOW, resolved or proof of safety (instance at adoption: CVE-2026-82560 in the API image's perl-base, no fix). A missing or unrecognized severity, a malformed report, an unknown scope and an incomplete analysis continue to fail closed, and a finding later classified CRITICAL falls under the unconditional CRITICAL rule.
_authority.vulnerability_scopes: ADOPTED. Every lock target the filesystem scan reports must be declared as runtime or development below; a target with no declared scope fails the analysis as incomplete, never defaulting to either. npm packages Trivy marks Dev are development scope inside package-lock.json. A built image is image scope. An installed tooling environment (a CI virtual environment or interpreter scanned as installed) is development scope.
_authority.misconfiguration_threshold: ADOPTED (operator order 2026-10-19), unchanged: CRITICAL/HIGH misconfigurations fail. The per-check exception file security/misconfig-exceptions.json (ADOPTED by the operator order of 2026-10-18 for six named findings) is retained unchanged; no exception is broadened. No ignore file is tracked.
_authority.sast_threshold: ADOPTED (operator order 2026-10-19), unchanged: Semgrep ERROR-severity findings fail; WARNING and INFO are reported. Any scanner error (rule timeout, parse failure) is an incomplete analysis and fails closed.
_authority.scanner_errors: ADOPTED, unchanged: a missing or malformed report fails (exit 2); a report that does not describe the claimed artifact or population fails as incomplete (exit 4); a required analysis that left no summary fails completeness.
_authority.sbom: ADOPTED (operator order 2026-10-19), unchanged: CycloneDX 1.5 to 1.7 JSON, validated for format, serial number, described component, non-empty package-component population and, for images, the same image id as the vulnerability report.

O1_2026_10_21.status: ADOPTED: a new, dated, bounded operator decision of 2026-10-21 (the order received 2026-10-21T01:48:22Z, recorded verbatim in the coordination evidence P6-programme-closeout-01, OPERATOR-ORDER-BINDINGS.txt, section 1). It is not a reading of the order of 2026-10-19, which did not explicitly settle this.
O1_2026_10_21.decision: "I adopt development/tooling scope for the Trivy and OpenTofu executables used as CI tools in this tranche, provided you verify that these classified artifacts are not shipped or executed as application runtime components."
O1_2026_10_21.condition_verified: 2026-10-21, no discrepancy: no COPY/RUN/ADD/FROM line of the API/worker or the reader Dockerfile and no ECS task definition names either executable; Trivy runs only on GitHub-hosted runners (ci.yml; staging-publish.yml and reader-publish.yml before publication), OpenTofu only in ci.yml's Revision reader job (fmt, init -backend=false, test), never against real state. The operator's own OpenTofu for manual applies is a separate binary this decision does not classify.
O1_2026_10_21.enforced_as: vulnerabilities.binary_scope = development, read by the binary gate (security/gate.py vuln --kind binary) for the binaries security/scanner-binaries.json pins; a missing or unrecognised value fails the policy closed (exit 2).
limbs_verbatim: Trivy-selected CRITICAL findings continue to fail regardless of fix availability.
Development/tooling HIGH findings remain reported under the existing adopted severity rules.
OpenTofu’s 28 reported HIGH findings remain unresolved findings. Preserve their identities, affected versions, available fixes and limitations; assign an accountable follow-up owner.
This is not a finding-specific exception, remediation claim or declaration that the tools are safe.
It authorizes no AWS execution, IAM change, deployment or provider activation.

A component shipped or used at runtime retains its applicable image/runtime treatment. Vendored packages inherit the scope of their containing environment; they do not receive a universal tooling exemption.
O1_2026_10_21.where_carried: CRITICAL and HIGH: vulnerabilities.severity_rules, unchanged; the binaries' scope: vulnerabilities.binary_scope; the 28 findings with identities, affected versions, fixes and limitations: security/README.md (Coverage-gap tranche, repair 4) and every Revision reader scanner-binaries gate summary; the owner: open_findings below.

O1_2026_10_21.vendored_packages: The packages an installed pip vendors (analysed from a staged list of the pins in its vendor.txt) take the scope of the environment they are installed in: the installed CI tooling environments are development scope under _authority.vulnerability_scopes. The shipped images carry no pip (the image gate fails on any); other vendored or bundled code inside a shipped image is runtime content with image scope, and today it is not analysed (security/README.md, populations table; operator decision table D4b).
